technical_quality: Adequate PA film: good inspiration (about 9 posterior ribs), minimal rotation (medial clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate penetration; L side marker present at image upper right confirming conventional orientation; costophrenic angles and apices included.

devices.type: external radiographic side marker (L with circle / technologist ID marker)
devices.location: image upper right corner, over the patient's left shoulder soft tissues

abnormalities.finding: Dense irregular/lobulated opacity extending from the right hilum inferomedially along the right heart border (partially silhouetting the lower right heart border), ~6 cm; consistent with right middle lobe atelectasis with volume loss, but a hilar/perihilar mass or consolidation cannot be excluded
Mild elevation of the right hemidiaphragm relative to the left (~3.5 cm), supporting right-sided volume loss
Left hilar prominence, rounded (~2.5-3 cm) - possibly prominent left pulmonary artery versus hilar nodule/adenopathy; uncertain

description_zh: PA 胸部X光，吸氣量尚可、無明顯旋轉，影像右上角可見「L」側別標記。右側下肺野內側（右肺門下方、緊鄰右心緣）可見一約6公分之緻密不規則陰影，部分遮蔽右心緣下段，並伴右側橫膈輕度上抬，符合右中葉肺塌陷（atelectasis）合併體積減少之表現，惟不能完全排除肺門腫塊或實質化。左肺門略顯突出，疑為左肺動脈突出或肺門結節，建議進一步評估。未見肋膜積液、氣胸，亦無任何導管、引流管或植入裝置。
